UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User account preferences and theme selection stored per authenticated user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document owner.

displayName.description: Display name shown on the Perfil screen.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on mutation.

UserTrack.title: UserTrack
UserTrack.description: User track metadata and favorite status synced to the cloud.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document owner.

favorite.description: Whether the user marked the track as favorite.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on mutation.

CatalogArtist.title: CatalogArtist
CatalogArtist.description: Shared cloud catalog artist managed by the verified admin and readable by signed-in users when published.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin creator.

bio.description: Short artist biography or genre tags.

photoUrl.description: HTTPS download URL of artist photo in Firebase Storage, or empty string.

published.description: Whether this artist is visible to all signed-in users.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on mutation.

CatalogAlbum.title: CatalogAlbum
CatalogAlbum.description: Shared cloud catalog album linked to an artist.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin creator.

artistId.description: Document ID of the parent CatalogArtist.

coverUrl.description: HTTPS download URL of album cover in Firebase Storage, or empty string.

published.description: Whether this album is visible to all signed-in users.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on mutation.

CatalogTrack.title: CatalogTrack
CatalogTrack.description: Shared cloud catalog audio track playable via streaming or offline download.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin creator.

artistId.description: Document ID of the parent CatalogArtist.

albumId.description: Document ID of the CatalogAlbum, or empty string for singles.

albumTitle.description: Album title or empty string for singles.

trackNumber.description: Track order within the album or release.

audioUrl.description: HTTPS download URL of the audio file in Firebase Storage.

coverUrl.description: HTTPS download URL of the cover art or empty string.

published.description: Whether this track is visible to all signed-in users.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on mutation.

AppReleaseConfig.title: AppReleaseConfig
AppReleaseConfig.description: Latest GitHub Release version metadata published by Admin for in-app update notifications.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin who published the release.

latestVersionCode.description: Latest Android versionCode available for download.

downloadUrl.description: HTTPS GitHub Release URL for the updated APK.

releaseNotes.description: Summary of improvements and changes in the release.

mandatory.description: Whether the update dialog should hide the dismiss button.

/users/{userId}.description: User profile document holding app theme preference.

/users/{userId}/tracks/{trackId}.description: User-scoped library tracks and favorite state.

/catalog_artists/{artistId}.description: Global cloud catalog of artists published by Admin.

/catalog_albums/{albumId}.description: Global cloud catalog of albums published by Admin.

/catalog_tracks/{trackId}.description: Global cloud catalog of songs published by Admin for streaming and offline download.

/app_config/{configId}.description: App release configuration document (release) for GitHub Releases update alerts.
